BPM Pipeline final step. Publishes a 1.Deliverables/ sidecar folder that COPIES the key business-facing artifacts (process_map.md/mmd/bpmn, process_model.json, L2_process_map.md/json) with clean canonical filenames. Non-destructive by design — leaves all upstream capability outputs untouched at the flat root of output/ so step reruns can find their state-path inputs regardless of when finalize ran. Leading 1. in the folder name puts it first in the Documentation UI file tree.
Create the single root BusinessDomain node (Ferguson / Build.com) and link it to every DispatchHandler (EXPOSES) and BusinessEntity (HAS_ENTITY) touched by this run.
Extract real DDD business entities from csp/<area> *-api and *-domain modules (denylist-based, Lombok-field-aware), not JSP/servlet artifacts.
Extract EXEC CICS commands from COBOL paragraph snippets.
Generate markdown documentation for application flow.
Binds BMS field names to COBOL copybook variables using the CICS I/O/L/F suffix convention, and links program paragraphs to the BMS maps they SEND/RECEIVE.
Links CICSTransaction nodes to their COBOL Program nodes by locating source files and establishing relationships.

Reads CopybookReference nodes from the Neo4j graph, parses the referenced copybook source files, and emits ResolvedDataItem nodes linked back to the program so the data dictionary reflects the inlined copybook content.
Scans COBOL/CICS/JCL codebases to identify and register entry points (BatchJob and CICSTransaction nodes) in Neo4j ontology graph.
Parses COBOL source files into the documented structural graph nodes and containment edges.
Uses the COBOL structural graph and an LLM to generate Java source files for each COBOL program.
Expands BatchJob nodes in Neo4j graph by parsing JCL files to create JobStep, DataSource, and execution flow relationships.
Parses COBOL copybooks (data items) and CICS BMS maps (screens) into a UI-ready Neo4j graph with position, attributes, colors, and navigation keys.
Analyzes COBOL paragraph snippets from the graph and creates performs, reads_variable, and writes_variable edges.
Parses COBOL programs into a structural Neo4j graph: divisions, sections, paragraphs, data items (with PIC/USAGE/OCCURS), file selectors, file descriptions, EXEC blocks, and copybook references.

Map data lineage: emit DATA_FLOWS_TO from ContractRequestParam to SQLStatement when names match, FORM_FIELD_BACKS from UIField to ContractRequestParam, and INTENT_EXECUTES_SQL shortcut edges from IntentImplementation to SQLStatement reachable via its evidence files.
Propose unified REST + Angular architecture using 4-pass layered design.

Corrects dispatch_table 'action' values for verb_mapping/request_mapping handlers corrupted by dispatch_handler_table_builder's @XMapping(value = "...") keyword-form parsing bug, by re-scanning the same source with an annotation-argument-aware value extractor, and renames the matching DispatchHandler graph node so downstream matches still find it.
Detect controller dispatch patterns (Spring @RequestMapping / @GetMapping/@PostMapping etc, switch(funcion), if-else chains) and emit action → handler-method tables.
Load explicit COBOL application entrypoint configuration and link it to a CICS transaction.

Scan Java source for side-effect boundaries (SOAP/REST/JMS/audit/notification/file IO/XML transform/transactions). Detects nearby artifact paths (.jrxml/.xsl/.wsdl/.xsd) and emits USES_TEMPLATE/USES_TRANSFORM/USES_CONTRACT/USES_SCHEMA edges from ExternalBoundary to ScopeFile.
Connect BMS fields to COBOL variables and application data.
Parse iBatis / MyBatis SQL map XMLs; emit SQLStatement + SQLTable nodes and REFS_TABLE edges.

Per IntentImplementation, walk evidence_files + operation_details to emit direct INTENT_USES_TEMPLATE / INTENT_USES_TRANSFORM / INTENT_USES_CONTRACT / INTENT_USES_SCHEMA edges to ScopeFile (.jrxml/.xsl/.wsdl/.xsd), so queries don't need to traverse 3 hops.

For each ScreenIntent, fuse call chain + executed SQL + side-effect boundaries (incl. nearby artifact paths) into an IntentImplementation: business_logic, client/server validations, business_rules, data_flow, call_chain, operation_types, operation_details (with target artifacts), infrastructure_deps, evidence_complete. Emits ImplOperation nodes + DEPENDS_ON_TEMPLATE/TRANSFORM/CONTRACT/SQLMAP edges to ScopeFile.

BFS from seed JSPs/classes/beans through Spring DI + JSP includes + Java imports + controller forwards + iBatis refs; emits ScopeFile nodes with file_type and DISCOVERS edges. When focused_ingestion.portlet config is present (workflow_prop or state from portlet-entry-resolver): applies exclude_bean_ids + exclude_simple_name_patterns at every bean-queue hop, restricts JSP search roots to jsp_base/module_name, defaults dir_scan_fallback OFF, and replaces eager shared-context auto-glob with explicit additional_spring_contexts. Without focused config, behaves as before for backward compatibility.

Fail-fast preflight for the J2EE AS-IS workflow. Verifies source_path is reachable, portlet.xml exists, and every focused_ingestion.portlet.discovery_paths + additional_spring_contexts entry actually resolves under source_root. Stops the cascade-failure pattern where a focused_ingestion typo (e.g. 'src/main/java' instead of 'src') surfaces 7 steps deep as 'class_index is empty'. Should run FIRST in the j2ee_asis workflow.
BFS through Java method calls (controller → service → DAO); emit Method nodes + CALLS edges; link DAO methods that execute SQL statements via EXECUTES_SQL.
For each Java file, produce a simple-name → FQN resolution map using imports, same-package siblings, wildcard imports (via class_index), and java.lang implicits.
BFS Java import statements + extends/implements relationships from a seed set of files to compute the dependency closure within a source tree.
Generates markdown documentation for JCL jobs from BatchJob/JobStep/DataSource graph nodes.
Extract AJAX + form API contracts from JSPs; emit APIContract / ContractRequestParam / ContractResponseField nodes with CONTRACT_HAS_* and RESPONSE_POPULATES edges.
Extract dynamic UI behavior from JSPs; emit VisibilityRule / CascadingRule / ClientValidation nodes attached to UIScreen via SCREEN_HAS_* edges.
Recursively inline JSP includes and emit JSPFile nodes + INCLUDES edges; cycle/depth safe.

Parse JSPs into UI blueprint; emit UIScreen / LayoutSection / UIField / FieldGroup / ActionButton / ModalDialog / DataGrid nodes with SCREEN_HAS_*, MODAL_HAS_FIELD, SECTION_CONTAINS_FIELD, FIELD_MEMBER_OF edges.

Read portlet.xml + Spring context XML to resolve a portlet's entry action to a Spring bean and supporting paths. Passes optional focused_ingestion config (module_name, jsp_base, bean_filters, additional_spring_contexts) through to state so downstream skills can scope ingestion to a single module.

Joins URL-level SecurityRules with method-level auth-gate info and assigns each gateway DispatchHandler one of five access classifications: pre_login_open, guest_allowed, post_login_required, internal_or_partner, not_gateway_fronted.

For each UIScreen, bundle UI blueprint summary + JSP source + included fragments + linked controller Java source into one LLM-ready text per screen.
Call ctx.any_llm on each bundled screen context; extract ScreenIntent nodes (trigger, backend_depth, operation_type, unknowns) and link them to UIScreen, APIContract, ActionButton, and other intents.
Create normalized screen models from BMS maps and COBOL/CSD context.
Finds and classifies all source files in the input application.

Index a source tree: build {class_fqn -> path} for Java files and classify non-Java artifacts. Reads focused_ingestion from upstream portlet-entry-resolver state (single source of truth). When focused_ingestion.portlet.discovery_paths is present, derives include_paths from java_src/jsp_base/spring_xml_base and applies bean_filters.exclude_class_patterns + module.exclude_patterns to skip Java files at index time. Without focused config, indexes everything.

Filesystem walk (independent of class_index) for Spring Security HttpSecurity/SecurityFilterChain config classes; extracts permitAll/denyAll/hasAnyRole/hasRole per URL pattern and detects anonymous-role overrides.
Parse Spring XML config files: extract bean definitions and emit SpringBean nodes + DEPENDS_ON_BEAN edges.
